response.sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) IS NOT NULL), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS b FROM telescopes) SELECT AVG(s.avg_usage) AS mean_of_station_averages, AVG(s.avg_usage - b.b) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE s.avg_usage > b.b

assumptions.assumption: The baseline is the average of bandusagepct over all telescopes with a non-null value, with each telescope counted once. This is not an average of the station averages.
Stations are grouped by the observstation column in telescopes. Stations that have no telescopes or only null bandusagepct values are excluded.
If no station is above the baseline, the query returns one row with NULL values.
